entities.summary: Aleksey Nikolayevich Ovchinin is a Russian cosmonaut and holds the rank of Podpolkovnik in the Russian Air Force Reserve. He was selected as a cosmonaut in 2006 and made his first spaceflight in 2016 on Soyuz TMA-20M, where he also served as commander.
